title: The symmetric quotient and colour sectors
html: The quotient B_3 \twoheadrightarrow S_3 obtained by imposing \sigma_i^2 = \mathrm{id} corresponds to passing from a braided monoidal category to a symmetric monoidal one, requiring c_{V,V}^2 = \mathrm{id}. In the Descartes universe, the three copies of S_3 inside S_5 = \mathrm{Aut}(\Sigma_4) are images of three such quotients. Each quotient corresponds to a colour sector \mathfrak{r}, \mathfrak{g}, \mathfrak{b}. Lifting these three S_3 subgroups back to B_3 via the braiding of \mathrm{Rep}(\mathrm{SU}_q(2)) recovers the non-trivial exchange phases that distinguish quarks from leptons.
